contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [IMP CONSTANTINVS P AVG] ; R/ [M]ARTI PAT-RI PRO PVG

A copper-alloy Roman nummus of Constantine I (AD 306-337), dating to the period AD 307-312 (Reece period 15). MARTI PAT-RI PRO PVG reverse type depicting Mars naked, advancing right, holding transverse spear and shield. Mint of London. Cf. RIC VI, p. 132, no. 109. Obverse description: Laureate and cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: [IMP CONSTANTINVS P AVG]. Reverse description: Mars…
